title: The man in the red plaid shirt was a mantis in a red uniform (hypnotic regression)

tellings.quote: when I went through the regression and realized that the bug dream and the mountain bike dream were not two separate events and the red plaid shirt was a uniform
tellings.difference: Dates the regression to 2018 and adds that it showed the bug dream and the mountain bike incident were one event.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Blitch's regression revealed that the man in the red plaid shirt from the 1995 mountain bike incident was wearing a uniform.

as_told.title: Regression links bug dream and mountain bike incident

plain: A man in a red plaid shirt that John Blitch remembered from a 1995 incident at Daniels Park, Colorado, turned out under hypnotic regression (hypnosis used to recover buried memories) to be a mantis-like being in a red uniform. Blitch, a former scientist at the Pentagon's research agency DARPA, tells Michels that the regression, linked to Leo Sprinkle, also showed that a strange "bug dream" and a mountain bike outing he had kept separate were one event. In one telling he dates the regression to 2018.
